items.text: Henohu chawija chakudya mankendi akadi iluŋi, chi kweti ijina dapaseka, hichikuswila kwakwihi.
Akulumpi jawatupristu niansoneki hiyakukeŋa hakumujahila, muloŋa atiyili antu woma.
Satana hakwijila mudi Yudasi atumbawu ijina di kwawu daIsakaroti, wadiŋi wahekumi nayedi.
Hakuya, hakutiyaloŋana nawawakulumpi jawatupristu niakulumpi janjita, mwakumuhena kudi wena.
Atiya nikuwaha; hiyakutiyaloŋana nindi kumwinka mali.
Yena hakwitiya, hakukeŋa hatela kumuhenena kudi wena hakadi izaza dawantu.
Chidinashiki ifuku damankendi akadi iluŋi, dajahaŋawu paseka,
hakutemesha aPetulu naYowanu nindi, Yenu namutuloŋesheli paseka, twakadyi.
Wena hiyakumwihula nawu, Wunakeŋi tuloŋesheli kudihi?
Yena hakuyila nindi, Chimukushika muŋanda, kukuyibulakana iyala nasendi nsaba yameji; mwakamulondi mwitala mwakwijila yi.
Mwakamwili mwini itala nenu, Nkuluŋaŋa neliuli nindi, Itala dawenyi dinakadiila paseka nawatumbanji twami didihi?
Yena wakayileja itala dahewulu deneni, mudi yuma yakupoŋomwena dehi; dimu mwakaloŋeshela.
Hiyakuya, hiyakuwana mwomwayilejayi; aloŋesha nipaseka.
Chiyinashiki mpinji, hakushakama hamu nawapostolu.
Hakuyila nindi, Nafwili kudya nenu pasekiyi, hinichidi kanda nikabi.
Muloŋa nukuyileja nami, kuyidya cheŋi, chiŋa yinalumbuluki dehi chalala muwanta waNzambi.
Hakutambula lupasa, chanasakililiyi hakwila nindi, Tambulenu lwenilu munwi wejima wenu.
Ami nukuyileja nami, kufumisha kulelu hinakanwa cheŋi yanyikabu yamuvinyuku, kunwa cheŋi, chiŋa wanta waNzambi wunenzi dehi.
Hakunona dinkendi, chanasakililiyi hakudihumuna, hakuyinka, nindi, Weniwu diwu mujimba wami wanahanuwu hanyijimba yenwenu; ilenuŋa mwenimu muŋanakanaŋa nachu.
Mwomumu nawa, cheliluwu anadyi dehi, hakunona lupasa nindi, Lupasilu dichi chitiyaŋenu chachiha chamumashi ami, awa akuyipwekela.
Talenu, chikasa chanfukeji chidi hamu nachami hamesa.
Muloŋa Mwana kamuntu chalala hakuya, mwomwatoŋweluwu dehi; o yihuŋu yakamona muntu wukumufukeja!
Wena hiyakutachika kudihujola nawu mukwetwinyi wukwila chumichi?
Mukachi kawu himukuvulumuka ntaai yakwila nawu mwinetwinyi aketejawu nawu nabadiki akwawu?
Yena hakuyila nindi, Anyanta jawaJentili ayiyulaŋa; niakweti wanta mukachi kawu ayitenaŋa nawu akwakuwahisha akwawu.
Ilaŋa enu bayi mwilaŋa omuku. Nabadiki akwawu mukachi kenu ekali neyi kansi, niwalema ekali neyi mukwakukalakela akwawu.
Muloŋa nabadiki hinyi, wakalakalaŋa, tahindi iwu nashakami nakudya? Netu, iwu nashakami nakudya. Ilaŋa ami nidi mukachi kenu nimukwakukalakala.
Enu munakakeli kushakama nanami mwanaŋesekuwu;
ami nukuyikunjika wanta wenu, neyi chankunjikiluwu ami kudi Tata yami,
kulonda mwakadyi nakunwa kumesa yami muwanta wami, mwakashakami hamatanda awanta nakusompesha nyuza yaIsarela ikumi nayiyedi.
Eyi Shimona, Shimona, Satana nayilombi dehi kulonda ayisali neyi tidiku;
ilaŋa ami nakulembeleli kulonda kukuhwelela kweyi kubulikukaŋanya. Nineyi, chiwakabalumuka mumuchima, wakakoleshaŋa ana kweyi.
Petulu hakumwila nindi, Mwanta neteji kuya naneyi hela mukaleya hela tuhu kufwa.
Hakumwila nindi, Eyi Petulu, nukukuleja nami, ikombu kwidikila lelu chiŋa eyi wunasambili dehi kudikala kasatu neyi hinamwiluka Yesuku.
Hakuyila nindi, Chinayitemesheli chakadi hela chikwama hela ipakumuna hela nkwabilu, mwakaankilili chuma, tahindi? Nawu, Nehi.
Hakuyila nindi, Ichi dinu, yowu wukweti chikwama asendi, niipakumuna chochimu; nabuli mpoku yakabali alandishi kahuma kindi kulonda alandi yimu.
Muloŋa nukuyileja nami, chuma chasonekeluwu chakuntenami chakwila nawu, Amubombeli bamu nawakwakuputola; keŋa chilumbulukili mudami. Muloŋa nsaŋu jasonekawu dehi jejima jakuntenami keŋa jimani.
Wena nawu, Mwanta, tala mpoku jatubali jiyedi ŋi. Yena hakuyila nindi, Jinawani.
Hakwidika, hakuya kumpidi yaOliveta neyi chelilaŋayi; atumbanji niwena hiyakumulondela.
Chanashikiyi kwayilaŋayi, hakuyila nindi, Lombenu mubuli kwijila mukweseka.
Hakwambuka nawu kuleha neyi mwakunatila ilola, hakufukama nakulomba,
nindi, Eyi Tata, neyi wuneteji anfumishi lupasilu; ilaŋa bayi ela munakeŋamuku, chiŋa muwunakeŋeyi.
Hikukumumwekena kaŋelu wakufuma mwiwulu nakumukolesha.
Hakulwisha nankashi, hakusweja kulomba; masulwilindi hiyakwila kafwampi neyi malekileki amashi aweni hiyakuholokela hamaseki.
Hakunyamuka kukulomba kwindi, hakwinza kudi atumbanji, hakuyiwana anakami dehi tulu twakuneŋa.
Hakuyila nindi, Munakaminidi tulu? Hindukenu mulombi, mubuli kwijila mukweseka.
Iku wuchidi kuhosha, kutala izaza dawantu, ninowu wahekumi nayedi wukweti ijina daYudasi, natwaminuku. Hakwinza kwakwihi naYesu amupwepuli.
Ilaŋa Yesu hakumwila nindi, Eyi Yudasi, wufukeji Mwana kamuntu nakupwepula?
adiŋi nindi, chanamonuwu chakukeŋa kwilawu, hiyakwila nawu, Mwanta tutapani nampoku yakabali, tahindi?
Mwinawu wumu hakutapa ŋamba yakapristu muneni, kutapa kwakumuketula itu dachidiilu.
Yesu hakwila nindi, Nlekenu ntahi. Yokunka niitu dindi, yomukuswisha nikumukuswisha.
Yesu hakuyila awakulumpi jawatupristu niakulumpi jamashidika akutembeli, niakulumpi jawantu enjili nakumukwata, nindi, Munenzi nampoku jatubali nanyitondu neyi chakukwata ikombi?
Chinadiŋi nenu mutembeli hefuku hefuku, enu himwolweli makasenu nakunkwataku. Ilaŋa iyi himpinji yenu, hiŋovu yamwidima.
Hiyakumukwata, hiyakumutwala nakumwiŋija mwitala dakapristu muneni. Petulu hakulondela hahalehi.
Chanabutuluwu kesi muchipaŋu, hiyakushakama hamu, Petulu niyena hakushakama nawu.
Chaŋadima wumu chanamumoniyi nashakami kuchejeji chakesi, hakumushinshika nindi, Iwu muntu niyena wadiŋi nindi.
Yena hakudikala nindi, Eyi mumbanda, hinamwilukaku.
Chihanalehi chanti, mukwawu hakumumona, nindi, Nineyi wumwinawu. Petulu nindi, Eyi iyala, ami hinimwinawuku.
Chihanahiti neyi mpinji yimu, mukwawu hakumulamata nindi, Iwu muntu, chalala wadiŋi nindi, muloŋa niyena hikaŊaliliya.
Petulu nindi, Eyi iyala, ami kwami kwiluka chiwudi nakuhosha nehi. Iku wuchidi kuhosha, ikombu edikila nikwidikila.
Mwanta hakushetumuka, hakumutala Petulu. Petulu hakwanuka mazu aMwanta amwililiyi nindi, Lelu hakela ikombu wuchidi kanda edi kili, wakadikala kasatu neyi hinamwilukaku.
Hakwidika muchipaŋu nakudila chacheni.
Amayala adiŋi amukwata Yesu hiyakumuseha nikumweta.
Amukasa niihina hamesu, hiyakumwila nawu, Profwetaku! Nakweti hinyi?
Amuhosheli chatama yuma yi kwawu yayivulu, nikunamutuka.
Chikunachi awakulumpi jawaYudeya hiyakupompa nawawakulumpi jawatupristu niansoneki; hiyakumutwala muchota chawu,
nawu, Neyi wuKristu, tuleji. Hakuyila nindi, Neyi nukuyileja, himukwitiyaku.
Hela nukuyihula, himukuŋakulaku.
Kufumisha hanu, Mwana kamuntu akamushakamisha kuchikasa chaNzambi chachidiilu chaŋovu.
Wejima wawu hiyakwila nawu, Komana, eyi wuMwana kaNzambi? Yena nindi, Mwomwenomu mumunahoshi, muloŋa dichi chinidi.
Wena nawu, Tukeŋi nawa wunsahu wukwawu? Tunamutiyi dehi etu aweni kukanwa kindi yomweni.
